svg.text: EnergyHub — Evidence, Memory and Messages
Observation, command, acknowledgement and delivery are different events
ACQUIRE AND QUALIFY
PI30MAX + optional serialized read-only PV2
Fresh SOC, voltage, load and aligned Total PV
Read-only BMS, CO/CO2 and device evidence via HA
Reject invalid/stale values; unknown is not zero
HISTORY AND PLANNING
Fault/SOC anomaly journals and grid reliability
Daily consumption, solar and estimated grid import
Forecast/weather/schedule freshness and coverage
Historical reliability is separate from live grid
PERSIST BEFORE CONTROL
Durable uncertain-transition marker before writes
ACK/readback and final mode save are separate
A controller save failure blocks further writes
Uncertain restart needs attended verification
EVENT-TIME SOLAR OBSERVATION
Full five-minute measured window when qualified
Validate timestamps after HA reads complete
Gaps/stale/future data give unconfirmed values
Delayed messages retain the event-time PV meaning
MESSAGING AND LOGS
Family reports; technical warnings routed separately
Bounded queues, expiry, deduplication and retry
A successful log read is not a send acknowledgement
Log-check recovery does not prove device recovery
HONEST ACCEPTANCE BOUNDARY
Startup and source hashes are verified
Regression suites use fixtures, not live switching
Rare failure cases need attended validation
No exhaustive bug-free or exactly-once guarantee
The messenger interface is not a second hardware controller. Structured HA logs are not a complete 24-hour health record.
